implementationPlan.description: BASELINE / EXPORT AND TRANSITION INVENTORY. Before edits, record `git status --porcelain` for the exact nine paths, current HEAD, and all production line counts. Run the four-consumer focused lane standalone and require `Test Files 4 passed (4)` and `Tests 81 passed (81)` across the two owned focused tests plus run-only agent-wrapper-main.test.ts and src/runtime-entrypoint.test.ts; run `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` once as the pre-diff package baseline and retain its nonzero counts and exact failing paths. Inventory with per-file grep every exported main/verifier/wrapper symbol and every caller, plus the exact transition assertions for provisional record, spawn refusal, PID upgrade, exit cleanup/active deletion, verifier cancellation/containment, signal idempotence, and shutdown stage ordering. Treat run-only tests and caller files as compatibility consumers, not edit authorization.

EXTRACT PROCESS LIFECYCLE CONTRACTS AND PROVE THE BRIDGE RED. Create process-runner-lifecycle.ts by moving verbatim agent-wrapper-main's ProcessSignalProbe, private WrapperSignalSource, WrapperStopSignal, probeProcessAlive, createWrapperStopSignal, WrapperRuntimeShutdownResources, asError, and shutdownWrapperRuntime, plus verifier-process-runner's VerifierProcessContainmentReason, VerifierProcessContainmentError, VerifierProcessCancelledError, and VerifierProcessRunner callable contract. Use type-only NodeMission/VerifierRunCapture imports. In main and verifier modules, import what their implementations use and explicitly re-export exactly their pre-existing names from the old specifiers; do not duplicate classes, change options/factory signatures, or move any spawn/kill/output code. Deliberately withhold process-runner-lifecycle.js, then run only runtime-entrypoint's named `has an exact .js bridge for every runtime module` test and require it to go red naming this missing bridge; this scanner sees the new .ts directly, so no downstream lifecycle/refusal fence can answer first.

ADD THE PROCESS LIFECYCLE BRIDGE ONLY. Create process-runner-lifecycle.js as the repository-standard one physical line `export * from "./process-runner-lifecycle.ts";` with the repository newline convention. Add no default, logic, manifest/lock edge, generated roster, or caller edit. Leave agent-wrapper-main.test.ts run-only: its imports from the old main specifier must continue exercising the moved probe/stop/shutdown implementations by re-export identity.

EXTRACT THE STAFFING STATE MACHINE AND PROVE ITS BRIDGE RED. Create agent-wrapper-staffing.ts with a narrow `createAgentWrapperStaffing` lifecycle constructed only from the optional AgentSessionFence. It owns createStaffingGate, active promises, ordered cleanup failures, gate admission, activeCount/has/failureOutcome/recordFailures/settle, and one `start` operation receiving the already prepared kind/workItemId/sessionId/claimAggregateVersion/SpawnRequest, AgentSpawnStart, and AgentAuthorityCleanup. Move verbatim the provisional pid-less record before spawn, refused-record fail-closed return, synchronous/rejected/coded spawn handling, verbatim producer refusal code/layer, PID upgrade, exit resolve/reject cleanup+retire, and final active deletion. In agent-wrapper.ts replace those state fragments with this lifecycle while retaining authority dispatch, identity/session/claim/mission building, human/compiler offer order, attempt charging, and serialized runOnce queue. Do not re-export staffing from agent-wrapper's old public surface. Deliberately withhold agent-wrapper-staffing.js and run only the runtime-entrypoint bridge scanner; require red naming this bridge while process-runner-lifecycle.js is present, so this missing staffing edge is the sole scanner failure.

ADD THE STAFFING BRIDGE ONLY. Create agent-wrapper-staffing.js as the repository-standard one physical line `export * from "./agent-wrapper-staffing.ts";`. Add no default, root export, registry/roster entry, manifest/lock edit, or alternate authority path. The real consumer remains createAgentWrapper through its old specifier, and the existing owned agent-wrapper tests remain the held-out behavior proof rather than being weakened or rewritten around the new helper.

COMPATIBILITY, FILE-CAP, AND ADVERSARIAL REVIEW. Diff each moved block against its origin and prove there is one owner for every mutable state cell and transition: no duplicate gate/active/failure/closing/containment state; public/bin exports and class identity unchanged; spawn argv/options, signal-0 ESRCH/EPERM truth, cancellation/tree-kill/timer/stdio ordering, output-tail bounds, shutdown stage order, refusal codes/layers, and cleanup/retire ordering unchanged. Require agent-wrapper.ts, agent-wrapper-main.ts, and verifier-process-runner.ts below 400 lines and both new .ts files <=250 without minification. Then run the adversarial-self-review checklist for overlapping passes, instant child exit, spawn throw/refusal, provisional/PID commit failure, cleanup rejection, repeated signals/close, late process error, Windows stale PID, POSIX ESRCH, and containment callback throws. Before mutation capture exact-path status; agent-wrapper-staffing.ts is new/untracked, so back it up outside the repo under `$env:TEMP` with task/worker suffix and record SHA256. Temporarily bypass only its provisional `gate.record` call, run the existing named test `writes a provisional record BEFORE spawn admission, then upgrades it with the pid`, and require the journal assertion to go red: its fake fence admits, its spawn succeeds, and no claim/read/later refusal can answer first. Restore by a separate copy and in a separate call prove SHA256 equality; a green mutant is a finding, never evidence.

FINAL VERIFICATION. From the restored tree run exactly this 442-character shell:false foreground/unpiped gate and record exit 0 with nonzero Test Files/Tests lines: `node -e 'let{spawnSync:s}=require("child_process"),L=[["--filter","@moe/daemon","exec","vitest","run","--config=package.json","agent-wrapper","verifier-process-runner","runtime-entrypoint"],["--filter","@moe/daemon","typecheck"]];for(let a of L){let r=s("pnpm",a,{encoding:"utf8",shell:false}),o=r.stdout+r.stderr;console.log(o);if(r.status)process.exit(r.status);if(a[3]=="vitest"&&!/Test Files\s+[1-9][\s\S]*Tests\s+[1-9]/.test(o))throw 0}'`. Confirm the focused lane still reports four executed files, including the run-only main and runtime bridge consumers, then run `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` standalone/unpiped at the delivered tree, subtract the step-1 baseline failing paths, intersect the delta with these nine owned paths, and complete only if that intersection is empty; disclose foreign red verbatim. Record final physical line counts, one-line bridge contents, old-module export rosters, and exact-path status. No documentation change is required because all public/bin behavior and signatures are preserved.
